g.text: From imported profile to Redfish response
Source data stays unchanged; each instance works on its own copy in memory.
Read and modify the active copy
Time determines readings; requests trigger updates.
/_mock/reset restores the baseline and revokes sessions. --raw-fixtures disables additions.
